Topic.label: Volume and surface area of a sphere

Question:
When the radius of a sphere becomes 3 times its original value, how many times its original surface area does the sphere have?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_h112_q2_question_en.svg)
Solution: Surface area is proportional to the square of the radius: \(3^2=9\).
